step1_analysis.description: This circuit is a fully differential active-RC integrator/filter used as a loop filter in a continuous-time delta-sigma modulator. It provides noise shaping and high gain in the audio band to achieve high SNR, utilizing a two-stage cascaded amplifier design with Miller compensation.

paper_reference.title: A Delta-Sigma Modulator for a 1-Bit Digital Switching Amplifier

dc_gain.description: Closed-loop DC gain of the active-RC filter.

sky130_expected.reasoning: Determined by the feedback resistor ratio (assuming 100k/10k for typical audio integrator).

bandwidth.description: Unity gain frequency or -3dB bandwidth of the filter.

sky130_expected.reasoning: Determined by the RC time constant of the feedback network (assuming 100k and 1nF).

thd.description: Total Harmonic Distortion for a 1kHz sine wave.

sky130_expected.reasoning: Depends on the linearity of the op-amp and the voltage swing. Expected to be low due to high loop gain.

snr.description: Signal-to-Noise Ratio integrated over the audio band (10 Hz to 22 kHz).

sky130_expected.reasoning: Thermal noise from resistors dominates. Vnoise ~ sqrt(4kTR * BW).

step3_testbench.description: Testbench to measure AC response (Gain, Bandwidth), Transient response (THD), and Noise (SNR) of the Delta-Sigma loop filter.
step3_testbench.spice:
* Delta-Sigma Modulator Loop Filter Testbench
.lib "${SKY130_PDK}" tt
.param VDD=1.8

* Behavioral Amplifier Subcircuit (Fully Differential)
.subckt amplifier outP outN inP inN
G1 outP 0 inP inN 10m
G2 outN 0 inN inP 10m
R1 outP 0 100k
R2 outN 0 100k
C1 outP 0 1p
C2 outN 0 1p
.ends

* DUT (Modified to include 'X' for subcircuits and typical component values)
XOP2 N2 N0 N6 N4 amplifier
XOP1 N6 N4 A N3 amplifier
R1 N6 N7 1k
R2 N3 GND 10k
R3 A N2 100k
R4 N4 N5 1k
R5 N0 N3 100k
R6 A LABEL_NET_0 10k
C1 N2 N7 10p
C2 A N2 1n
C3 N0 N5 10p
C4 N0 N3 1n

* Differential Output Converter for easy measurement
E_diff out_diff 0 N2 N0 1

* Sources
VLABEL_NET_0 LABEL_NET_0 0 DC 0.9 AC 1 SIN(0.9 0.1 1k)

.control
* AC Analysis
ac dec 100 1 10Meg
let gain_db = vdb(out_diff)
let phase = 180/PI * cph(v(out_diff))
meas ac dc_gain find gain_db at=10
meas ac ugf when gain_db=0 fall=1
meas ac phase_margin find phase when gain_db=0 fall=1

* Transient Analysis
tran 1u 5m
meas tran vout_max max v(out_diff)
meas tran vout_min min v(out_diff)
fourier 1k v(out_diff)

* Noise Analysis
noise v(out_diff) VLABEL_NET_0 dec 100 10 22k
setplot noise1
print inoise_total onoise_total

quit
.endc
.end
